title: Two Girls Fooled Sherlock Holmes's Creator With Paper Fairies 🧚
caption:
Two girls fooled the creator of Sherlock Holmes 🧚
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In 1917 cousins Elsie Wright and Frances Griffiths photographed "fairies" in Cottingley, England. Arthur Conan Doyle wrote that they were real. In 1983 they admitted the fairies were paper cut-outs held up with hatpins, though they still said they had really seen fairies.
Would you have believed the photos? 👇
first_comment: The man who invented the greatest detective ever got fooled by two kids and some scissors. 🧚👇
